title: RAYE Leads the 2027 Grammy Names With 11
summary:
The names for the 69th Grammy Awards were announced on Monday, November 16. Women artists lead the biggest groups. British singer-songwriter RAYE has the most names, with 11, tying a record Beyoncé set in 2025.

RAYE's hit "Where Is My Husband!" was a big success. It is up for both record of the year and song of the year, and her album This Music May Contain Hope is up for album of the year.

Rosalía is next, with nine names. Her album Lux has her singing in 14 languages. She won song of the year and album of the year at the Latin Grammys last week.

Country star Ella Langley has seven names. Her song "Choosin' Texas" spent 27 weeks at number one on the Billboard pop chart, the longest run ever there. She wrote it with Miranda Lambert, who also has seven names.

Only Taylor Swift and Bruno Mars have won album of the year before, and Mars is the only male artist there this year. The winners will be announced in Los Angeles on Sunday, February 7, 2027.
why_it_matters: It can help you find new songs and singers to enjoy, just like discovering a favourite song on a playlist.

keywords.explanation: A singer-songwriter is a person who both writes songs and sings them.
Tying a record means matching the best result someone else has already set.
Billboard is a chart that ranks the most popular songs.
The Latin Grammys are music prizes for songs sung in Spanish and Portuguese.
In music prizes, a record can mean a single song that is judged on its own.

background_read: The Grammy Awards are prizes given to singers and musicians for their songs and albums.
Each year, a list of names is announced first, and the winners are named later at a ceremony.
Singers can be named in many groups at once, such as song of the year and album of the year.
